Assets.NotesMarkdown: History shows Stop loss and Take profit by default, and the level that closed a trade is tinted, red for SL and green for TP, like MT5. An optional Reason column shows TP, SL, SO (stop-out), Manual, Partial or Close by. The order ticket's Sell and Buy buttons are tinted red and green, and the chart's 1-click buttons a little stronger. Tab counts show only on Trade and Pending. In By symbol view the group row says 2 positions, and Stop loss and Take profit show Custom when the positions differ (hover to see each). The order confirmation mentions max slippage only when you set a limit. A disabled Trade Assistant stays in place, dimmed. The right column fits Order ticket, Trade Assistant, Sessions and Account without cutting off the Account section. Charts keep candles above the time axis and scale to include the longest wicks. Margin level turns amber below your margin call level and red below stop-out; both levels are now in the account menu.

Assets.NotesMarkdown: Clicks answer at once: orders, closes and changes show Sending… immediately and finish in a fraction of a second, even on a slow computer, and live prices no longer slow the window down. Sign in inside the main window: it opens at its last size, and with Remember me it signs straight in. Choose Live or Demo when you sign in; a demo account under Live is refused with a clear message. Every password field has a show/hide eye and a Caps Lock warning. Session expired, switch account and confirmations appear inside the window. Account details (F7) shows your group, leverage, margin call and stop-out levels and server. No sounds before sign-in, and the connection sound is a setting. Optional diagnostics log in Settings.

Assets.NotesMarkdown: Settings, New order, Modify and the other order windows now open as cards inside the terminal window, so the terminal keeps one taskbar entry; chart indicator and drawing panels stay small floating panels. Closing a card with typed changes asks before discarding them.

Assets.NotesMarkdown: One-click trading is instant: the position appears on the chart and in the Trade tab the moment you click, and updates to the confirmed price and ticket when the server answers; a rejected order is removed with a clear message. An order from the ticket shows Sending… only on the button you pressed; every other button stays available.

An order from the ticket shows Sending… only on the button you pressed; every other button stays available.

Assets.NotesMarkdown: Results of actions on several positions or orders are one short line, for example Break-even: 3 set · 18 skipped, with the reasons under why?. Messages disappear by themselves after a few seconds (hover to keep one, × to close it); the full history stays in the log. Before you sign in, the window shows the empty app behind the sign-in card, with no sample data.

Assets.NotesMarkdown: Sign-in always starts at the sign-in card; with Remember me your account is filled in, so you just click Sign In. Prices and your account load only after you sign in. The sign-in card shows only the broker's name; the version is in Settings, About. The Trade Assistant takes Stop loss and Take profit in pips by default, or as a price with the PIPS / PRICE switch.

Assets.NotesMarkdown: Pending orders and positions outside the visible chart now sit at the top or bottom edge at their price, never in a corner. Positions, SL and TP at the same price show as one label with a count (for example BUY x12 at 4177.80; hover to see them), or overlap in place if you switch grouping off in Settings, Chart. Turning the Trade Assistant on or off no longer cuts off the Sessions list.

Assets.NotesMarkdown: Position lines on the chart: BUY entries are green and SELL entries red, stop loss is a red dashed line and take profit a green dashed line. The pointer turns into a hand over a line or its label. Click a position line to see its live P/L with a button to close it; click a grouped label (BUY x14) to see the group's total P/L and close them all after a confirmation.

Assets.NotesMarkdown: Safety fix: changing Stop loss or Take profit for several positions now starts at No change; removing them must be chosen and confirmed. Clicking or double-clicking a position on the chart always opens its P/L box with Close, never the SL/TP editor. Fixes the Something went wrong message after applying changes.
